criteria.criterion: A "Get set up" card appears on Today for the owner, and only the owner, until every setup step is done; admins and staff never receive the checklist, and that is enforced where the data is read, not by hiding the card.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/setup/checklist.ts getSetupChecklist throws unless the caller is an active OWNER (read-level, not a hidden link); src/app/desk/today/page.tsx only asks for it when the role is OWNER and tolerates a failure; SetupCard returns nothing once all six are done. tests/setup-checklist-integration.test.ts (real Postgres) refuses admin, staff, customer, archived owner and unknown user; tests/today-workspace.test.tsx proves ADMIN/STAFF are never asked, the card hides when complete and a failure does not break Today.

criteria.criterion: The steps run in this order: business details, service area, prices, tax setup, payments, email.
criteria.evidence: SETUP_STEP_ORDER fixes the order; tests/setup-checklist.test.ts asserts it and tests/today-workspace.test.tsx asserts the rendered numbering 1 to 6.

criteria.criterion: Each step shows "Done ✓" or the one thing still missing, in plain words, worked out from what is actually saved (never from a tick box), and opens the exact existing screen where it is fixed.
criteria.evidence: Every step is computed from saved settings, prices, filing accounts and the business address (no stored tick). Done rows say "Done ✓"; others state the one thing missing. Every href is checked against the real route list and settings sections (tests/setup-checklist.test.ts); each transition is proven on real Postgres (setup-checklist-integration.test.ts); the link names read "Finish this, service area" etc. for screen readers.

criteria.criterion: Tax setup is done only when the sales tax account number, how often you file, the first filing period, the business address and the use-tax accounts for Colorado and Greeley are all in place, using the same answers as Taxes → Setup.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/tax/setup-readiness.ts holds the one definition, now used by both the Taxes overview and the Today card. An exhaustive 7x5x4 agreement test and a real-Postgres test against getTaxWorkspaceOverview prove they cannot disagree; a mutation test (ignoring address confirmation) failed as expected.

criteria.criterion: Payments and email report what is truly connected (test or live payment key, payment-sync secret, email service, sender address, customer-email switch); the card never turns anything on, sends or charges anything, and never shows a secret.
criteria.evidence: Payments: recognized Stripe key plus sync secret, reported only as connected/not and test/live. Email: service key, sender address and customer-email switch. Tests inject the environment and assert no key value appears anywhere in the output; the integration test proves the read writes no settings or audit rows.
